description: Implementation of SHA1 hashing functions optimized for word access, including initialization, update, and finalization routines, based on Mozilla's SHA1 implementation.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 context with standard constants.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Update
methods.description: Updates SHA1 hash with new data, processing in 64-byte blocks.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA1 hash, producing the digest.
